verdict.rationale: Docs show structural signals — 'chunk by title' strategies imply detection of headings/titles, partitioning strategy selection (Fast/High Res/VLM), and table-to-HTML preservation of table structure — which together indicate the product identifies document elements rather than dumping raw text. However, the evidence never explicitly states preservation of reading order across complex/multi-column layouts or nested section hierarchy beyond titles. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on proof of reading-order preservation across multi-column/complex layouts, and explicit section/heading hierarchy nesting in output schema.
